name: Line of sight
description: Test if an object has line of sight to (if it can "see") an object or position.

conditions.description: Test if there is line-of-sight to any instance of an object type.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Choose the object to test if line-of-sight covers.

image-point.name: Image point (optional)
image-point.desc: The name or number of an image point in the object to test line-of-sight to. Leave 0 for object's origin.

conditions.description: Test if there is line-of-sight to a position in the layout.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.

conditions.description: Test if there is line-of-sight between any two positions in the layout.

from-x.name: From X
from-x.desc: The X co-ordinate to test line-of-sight from, in pixels.

from-y.name: From Y
from-y.desc: The Y co-ordinate to test line-of-sight from, in pixels.

from-angle.name: Angle
from-angle.desc: The angle to orient the cone of view with, in degrees.

to-x.name: To X
to-x.desc: The X co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.

to-y.name: To Y
to-y.desc: The Y co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.

conditions.description: Test if the last cast ray intersected an obstacle.

actions.description: Set the maximum range the line-of-sight can cover.

range.name: Range
range.desc: The new maximum distance in pixels that line-of-sight can cover.

actions.description: Set the angle range relative to the object angle that line-of-sight can cover.

cone-of-view.name: Cone of view
cone-of-view.desc: The new angle range in degrees relative to the object angle that line-of-sight can cover.

actions.description: Add a custom object as an obstacle to line-of-sight.

obstacle.name: Obstacle
obstacle.desc: Choose an object to add as an obstacle, obstructing line-of-sight.

actions.display-text: Cast {my} ray from ({0}, {1}) to ({2}, {3}) (use collision cells [i]{4}[/i])
actions.description: Cast a ray between any two positions in the layout, checking for obstructions.

use-collision-cells.name: Use collision cells
use-collision-cells.desc: Enabling usually improves performance, but can be slower over very long distances.

expressions.description: Return the current range in pixels that line-of-sight can cover.
Return the current cone of view in degrees.
Return the X position of the hit position.
Return the Y position of the hit position.
Return the UID of the instance that was hit.
Return the distance between the ray origin and hit position.
Return the X position at a distance along the hit normal.
Return the Y position at a distance along the hit normal
Return the angle for the surface normal at the hit position.
Return the X position at a distance along the hit reflection angle.
Return the Y position at a distance along the hit reflection angle.
Return the absolute angle of the ray reflection at the hit position.

obstacles.name: Obstacles
obstacles.desc: Choose whether solids obstruct LOS or if to use custom objects added by events.
